_regression.why: The real Mizuguchi manifest as shipped on 2026-08-17, before house-to-house separation had any rule at all. Two farmhouses at (829,1683) and (772,1694) stand 2.0 ft apart at their raked corners - two pixels at 1 px = 1 ft - and merge into one long building at fit zoom. Caught by settlement-review, not by the gate. Frozen so the check cannot quietly stop having teeth: this is a whole real map, not a synthetic pair, and it is the artifact the rule was written against.
